record.body:
## Problem
The report and aggregate give numbers. Nothing turns them into proposed edits to se-workflow, adaptive-artifacts or the user's steering files. Many sessions also show no cost, which skews the numbers the skill would read.

## Approach
Add a user-invoked skill, skills/analyze-sessions/SKILL.md, with a disclosed reference file targets.md. The skill runs session_report.py --records and session_aggregate.py, reads caveats first, then looks for patterns: high tool error or retry rates, outlier sessions, skills used rarely or always followed by retries, efforts with heavy cost or errors. Each candidate names its metric and cites session references, and maps to one of four targets: se-workflow skills, the artifact contract, CLAUDE.md and steering files, or automated checks. The skill may read one named session's transcript with bounded reads for evidence. It proposes only and edits nothing until the user picks. Also fix the missing cost values so cost totals are trustworthy.

## Exit criteria
targets.md maps metric patterns to the four targets using field names from the aggregate output. SKILL.md is user-invoked, names both scripts by a path that exists, carries no store-writing command, and passes the skill contract consistency test. Cost is present for every session whose transcript has a cost-state line. A dry run on this machine's data yields candidates that each cite a metric and a session reference, and the user signs off on them.

payload.title: Skill that reads the report and proposes edits
